string.name: copy_number
string.comment: Menu action that copies a phone number to the clipboard.

string.name: create_new_contact
string.comment: Menu action that creates a contact from the selected phone number.

string.name: add_to_a_contact
string.comment: Menu action that adds the selected phone number to an existing contact.

string.name: send_message
string.comment: Menu action that starts a text message to the selected phone number.

string.name: edit_number_before_call
string.comment: Menu action that lets the user edit a phone number before calling it.

string.name: blockThisCaller
string.comment: Menu action that blocks calls and messages from the selected caller.

string.name: unblockThisCaller
string.comment: Menu action that removes the block from the selected caller.

string.name: delete
string.comment: Menu action that deletes the selected call-log entry.

string.name: anonymous
string.comment: Fallback caller name when the phone number is withheld.

string.name: placeholder_call_log
string.comment: Empty-state message shown when phone permission is required to display call history.

resources.string: Slå på telefontillatelser for å se anropsloggen

string.name: turn_on
string.comment: Button that opens settings to grant the permission required by the current screen.

string.name: open_contact
string.comment: Menu action that opens the selected person's contact details.

string.name: call_log_date_today
string.comment: Date-group heading for calls made or received today.

string.name: call_log_date_yesterday
string.comment: Date-group heading for calls made or received yesterday.

string.name: call_log_type_time
string.comment: Call-log summary. %1$s is the call type and %2$s is the call time.

string.name: call_log_call_count
string.comment: Number of calls grouped in a call-log row.

string.name: filter_all
string.comment: Call-history filter that includes every call.

string.name: filter_missed
string.comment: Call-history filter that includes only missed calls.

string.name: filter_voicemail
string.comment: Call-history filter that includes only voicemail entries.

string.name: filter_contacts
string.comment: Call-history filter that includes only saved contacts.

string.name: favorites
string.comment: Heading or navigation label for favorite contacts.

string.name: view_contacts
string.comment: Button that opens the full contact list.

string.name: add
string.comment: Button that adds the selected item.

string.name: remove
string.comment: Button that removes the selected item.

string.name: history
string.comment: Action that opens the selected contact's call history.

string.name: block_confirmation_title
string.comment: Title of the block-caller confirmation dialog. %1$s is the caller name or phone number.

string.name: block_confirmation_message
string.comment: Explanation in the block-caller confirmation dialog.

resources.string: Du vil ikke motta anrop eller meldinger fra dette nummeret.

string.name: delete_call_title
string.comment: Title of the dialog confirming removal of a call-log entry.

string.name: delete_call_message
string.comment: Explanation in the dialog confirming removal of a call-log entry.

string.name: cancel
string.comment: Button that dismisses the current dialog without applying changes.

string.name: update_available
string.comment: Heading for the call-log banner that announces a newer app release.

string.name: update_available_description
string.comment: Description for the call-log update banner. %1$s is the available version number.

string.name: update
string.comment: Button that opens the available app release in a browser.

string.name: dismiss_update_notification
string.comment: Accessibility label for the button that hides the update banner.
